merge_hold.finding: The synthetic browser network fence refused a non-loopback request; the original error did not identify its host. Subsequent reproduction and correction are recorded in follow_up_2026_11_09.
merge_hold.diagnostic_change: Report only the blocked hostname, never request paths, query strings or credentials. Refusal and test failure remain unchanged.
merge_hold.subsequent_ci: All maintained jobs, build, release guard and Vercel checks passed at diagnostic_code_commit; a repeat CI browser job also passed. These passes do not establish the cause of the original failure.

bounded_local_diagnostic.qualification: The original non-loopback request was not reproduced; successful repetitions do not clear the hold.

merge_hold.network_fence_probe: The exact generated intercept handler allowed two loopback cases and destroyed/refused two reserved non-local cases without continuing them; diagnostic errors omitted synthetic query data. No network requests were made by this probe.
merge_hold.disposition: The original hold was correct. Clear it only after the reproduced browser-startup cause is addressed and final exact-head gates pass; never bypass the fence or clear it solely on successful retries.

qualification: Registry audit findings are not distinct exploit counts or a security certification. Lower-severity development findings, runtime lifecycle support, application safety and credential gates remain open.

browser_smoke.scope: synthetic page, production minification and loopback dev server only

retained_failed_attempts: Windows Modern Standby interrupted the first local runs for roughly 54 minutes; affected groups were stopped and restarted without reusing incomplete results
Initial Cypress binary verification exceeded its 30-second startup wait; verification remained enabled and passed on the awake retry with a documented 120-second local startup allowance
Initial smoke used unsupported configFile:false; corrected to an explicit generated config in the synthetic temporary project, without loading repository configs or disabling the check
A later CI browser run refused an unexpected non-loopback request. Subsequent initial diagnostic runs passed without explaining it, so PR 300 was held in draft until the November 9 investigation
An ad-hoc local Node-spawned diagnostic stalled at browser startup and only its validated owned process tree was stopped; retained log was not counted as a passing run

follow_up_2026_11_09.observation: The request was refused before cy.visit could run: the test failed in under a second while a ten-second observation wait preceded the visit. The synthetic page and entry bundle contain no external requests. This identifies browser-startup traffic, not a DeedPro application/API request. The exact asset was not logged or identified.
follow_up_2026_11_09.correction: Process-local background/component/model-fetch controls for synthetic browsers, with previous launch arguments restored. Shared exact-origin policy and request/visit/redirect guards from merged PR 301 replace the separate host-only smoke fence. No remote host is admitted; all refusals remain blocking.
follow_up_2026_11_09.bounded_smoke: Three fresh browser launches, each with a ten-second guarded startup observation, one required passing fixture test and no skips. Stop on the first failed result, not retry-until-green.
follow_up_2026_11_09.negative_runtime_proof: One positive test plus two expected refusal failures with the required messages and zero hits at a forbidden local sentinel; the harness fails if any condition is absent. Maintained in CI after the toolchain smoke.
follow_up_2026_11_09.qualified_result: Frontend job passed all three browser starts and the refusal/redirect proof. Final evidence head must independently pass complete CI and preview before merge.
follow_up_2026_11_09.credential_direction: Owner requested engineering proceed independently of owner-managed credential work; no revocation verification or secret testing was performed.

historical_discovery_addressed_by_PR_301.finding: Legacy browser configuration and login helpers default to a deployed API. Account defaults and unsafe target behavior need separate review; no account values are reproduced here.
historical_discovery_addressed_by_PR_301.disposition: Resolved by owner-approved PR 301, merged as c1f9dacd and verified on main. Full application journeys remain unverified; these synthetic proofs do not exercise app code.
